summary: 60-year-old woman broke her ankle at about 10,975 feet at the Sneffels overlook on the Blaine Basin/Wilson Pass trail east of the Blue Lakes trailhead. An eight-person OMRT field team located her 4.8 miles from the trailhead; a helicopter made a difficult landing and picked her up.
location: Sneffels overlook, Blaine Basin/Wilson Pass trail
notes: Helicopter extraction after remote litter-planning fell through.
